map.法定继承份额计算器 使用指南: Statutory Inheritance Share Calculator User Guide
map.法定继承份额计算器依据《民法典》继承编，按第一、第二顺序继承人测算遗产分配比例，: The statutory inheritance share calculator follows the inheritance part of the Civil Code and computes the estate distribution ratio among first- and second-order heirs; suited to inheritance disputes, will planning and family property arrangements.
map.被继承人未立遗嘱时，按第一顺序继承人（配偶、子女、父母）均等分割遗产。: When the decedent left no will, the estate is divided equally among the first-order heirs (spouse, children and parents).
map.存在丧偶儿媳/女婿尽主要赡养义务的，作为第一顺序继承人。: A widowed daughter-in-law or son-in-law who provided the main support is treated as a first-order heir.
map.有遗嘱的，遗嘱继承优先于法定继承。: If there is a will, inheritance under the will takes precedence over statutory inheritance.
map.：遗产 200 万元，第一顺序为配偶 + 2 名子女（父母已故），3 人均等，每: : Estate 2,000,000 CNY, first order is the spouse plus 2 children (parents deceased), 3 people sharing equally, about 666,700 CNY each.
map.：遗产 200 万，继承人为配偶、1 子女、父、母共 4 人，每人 50 万元。: : Estate 2,000,000 CNY, the heirs are the spouse, 1 child, the father and the mother, 4 people in total, 500,000 CNY each.
map.子女包括非亲生的吗？: Do children include those who are not biologically related?
map.包括婚生子女、非婚生子女、养子女和有扶养关系的继子女；尽了主要赡养义务的丧偶儿媳: This includes children born in and out of wedlock, adopted children, and stepchildren in a support relationship; a widowed daughter-in-law or son-in-law who provided the main support may also be in the first order.
map.遗嘱和法定继承冲突怎么办？: What if the will conflicts with statutory inheritance?
map.遗嘱继承优先；但缺乏劳动能力又没有生活来源的继承人应保留必要份额，该部分不受遗嘱: Inheritance under the will takes precedence; but an heir who lacks the ability to work and has no source of income must be left a necessary share, which the will cannot reduce.
